<thought>The spectrum shows a dominant M peak with a ~10 % M+1 and ~1 % M+2 pattern, which matches the natural 13C (≈1.1 % per carbon) distribution for a molecule containing several carbons. No other element shows its characteristic isotopic signature (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
